spans.s: छेक a. (f. का) 1. Tame, domesticated (as a beast); 2. town-bred, shrewd, trained in the acuteness and vice of towns.
छेक a. (f. का) 1. Tame, domesticated (as a beast); 2. town-bred, shrewd, trained in the acuteness and vice of towns.

छेक-अनुप्रास m. a kind of alliteration consisting in a single repetition of two or more consonants; (the following is the example given by K.Pr.- ततोऽरुणपरिष्पंदमंदीकृतवपुः शशी । दध्रे कामपरिक्षामकामिनीगंडपांडुताम्).
छेक-अपह्नुति f. figure of speeck thus defined and illustrated by Jayadeva- छेकापह्नुतिरन्यस्य शंकातस्तथ्यनिह्णवे । प्रजल्पन् मत्पदे लग्नः- कांतः किं- न हि नूपुरः Chandrāloka.v.
छेक-उक्ति f. insinuation, double entendre, hint.
